config.section.chibi_sensei.label: Chibi Sensei
config.section.chibi_sensei.desc: Train small models on your own examples.
help.chibi_sensei.enabled: Shows the Chibi Sensei app on the desktop. The dataset studio works locally; training runs on Kaggle and needs the Kaggle permissions.
config.chibi_sensei.disabled_desc: Switch it on to show the app on the desktop.
config.chibi_sensei.storage_max_gb_help: Upper limit for all Chibi Sensei files on this server.
config.chibi_sensei.dataset_max_rows_hel: A project refuses new rows above this number.
config.chibi_sensei.import_max_rows_help: The most rows one import may add.
config.chibi_sensei.import_max_file_mb_h: Files above this size are refused.
config.chibi_sensei.generator_provider_h: Empty uses the main AuraGo model.
config.chibi_sensei.generator_model_help: Overrides the model of the chosen provider.
config.chibi_sensei.generator_max_rows_p: The most examples one generation run may create.
config.chibi_sensei.training_machine_sha: The graphics card Kaggle uses for training. It must also be ticked under “Allowed GPU types” in the Kaggle settings.
config.chibi_sensei.training_delete_remo: Delete the Kaggle copies after a run
After a run AuraGo deletes the uploaded dataset and the notebook on Kaggle. This needs the delete permission in the Kaggle settings; without it both stay on Kaggle and the run lists them.
config.chibi_sensei.later_note: Local testing and the Sensei chat get their settings in later versions.
